description: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of real-user demand for different context lengths, categorized by input and output demands. The horizontal axis displays the context length categories: 2K-Input, 4K-Input, 8K-Input, 16K-Input, 2K-Output, 4K-Output, 8K-Output, and 16K-Output, arranged alphabetically, with each category represented by a distinct bar. The vertical axis is labeled “Number” and extends from 0 to 120000, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20000.  There are eight bars in total, with the 4K-Input bar, colored solid red, being the tallest, reaching a value of 108494. The 2K-Output and 4K-Output bars are visually distinguished by diagonal slash filling, with approximate values of 9320 and 78188, respectively. The 2K-Input bar, colored yellow, has a value of 3784, while the 8K-Input bar, colored blue, has a value of 17865.  The 8K-Output bar displays a value of 1401, the 16K-Input bar displays a value of 832, and the 16K-Output bar displays a value of 4247.  All bars are individually colored and do not appear to be grouped or stacked; each bar represents a single category’s value without any visual emphasis.
